rules.statement: In the circumstances, it would be wholly unreasonable to authorise a decree for ejectment if the effect of such a decree would involve the tenant in very considerable financial loss and throw him out of business altogether.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that, in the circumstances, it would be wholly unreasonable to authorise a decree for ejectment."

meta.parties: Abdul W. M. N. Hameen v. Sugathadasa, H.S.P
